reason: A PostgreSQL-backed DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent multi-device session storage, single-writer handoff, session migration, and authenticated observation and management APIs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 PostgreSQL 的多设备 Session 持久化、单写入者接力、迁移及受认证的管理接口。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides PostgreSQL-backed multi-device session persistence, single-writer handoff, migration, and authenticated management APIs.

capabilities: Stores and retrieves session event data in PostgreSQL
Enforces single-writer session handoff and fencing
Exposes authenticated HTTP and SSE session endpoints
Creates handoff credentials and supports administrator recovery
Imports and rolls back existing session data
Installs, upgrades, and uninstalls the DSH profile adapter
